description.value: You adjust the appearance of the target's clothes, make-up, and hair in addition to using effects like soft lighting, sparkles, or even less-than-subtle visual effects like rose-petals or bubbles to help highlight their appeal. When you @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.o8lqmFexiwcaLpu3]{Set the Spotlight} on yourself, you can @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.ttL2TstfSqOyzCd2]{Cast a Role} to apply the romance role to yourself as a free action. As long as you are in a spotlight with a romantic role, you can use Performance in place of Diplomacy to [[/act request skill=performance]].
